English: Archery Range
Makeshift straw targets and wooden posts allow townsfolk to hone their archery skills, providing basic urban defense and hunting practice.
Barracks
The first permanent timber structure for city guards and militia, providing bunks and a small armory for better organization.
Drill Yard
A rough open space with dirt boundaries where new arrivals practice basic drills and formations under simple supervision.
Parade Ground
A leveled, fenced field for regular drills, musters, and displays, enhancing the discipline and morale of the citys defenders.
Watch House
A sturdy stone building for the city watch, featuring a lookout tower and secure holding cells to keep order and deter crime.
Weapons Depot
A large, secure warehouse for storing arms, crossbows, and armor, enabling faster arming of militia and improving city defense.
Veterans' Quarters
Comfortable barracks for seasoned soldiers, encouraging them to train new recruits and bolster the citys military expertise.
Command Hall
An imposing hall where officers and commanders coordinate city defense, manage rosters, and plan strategic responses to threats.
Garrison Complex
A sprawling fortified compound with multiple barracks, supply buildings, and an inner keep for the citys militia and watch.
War Academy
A prestigious institution for training officers, strategists, and militia captains, renowned throughout the realm for its military instruction.
